nodes.name: New email (IMAP)
nodes.notes: Set up the IMAP credential inside n8n's Credentials UI (Settings > Credentials), never in this file. Point it at the shared mailbox subscribed to platform alert emails (OnlineTenders and friends, per artboard P2-02 Method 2).

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ model: 'claude-sonnet-5', max_tokens: 1024, system: 'Extract tender_no, client, title and closing_at (ISO 8601) from this tender alert email. Reply with ONLY a JSON object with those four keys, using null for anything not stated. Never guess a value.', messages: [{ role: 'user', content: $json.text || $json.html || '' }] }) }}

nodes.name: Claude: extract fields
nodes.notes: Store the Anthropic API key as an n8n credential, not inline. This is a plain HTTP call rather than Piccolo's own extraction pipeline (packages/extraction) because email alerts are short text, not documents needing OCR - no tool-use/structured schema needed here, just a JSON reply the Code node below parses defensively.
